findings.text: non-blocking: the case patches reckon.crew.directory.directory, which serve_crew_view imports inside its own body (reckon/mcp_views.py:4188), so the stand-in intercepts only while that call is made through the submodule at call time; if the import moved to module scope, or the directory branch called any other accessor, the patch would stop biting and the case would redden on a contract that is still true. It is a much narrower dependency than the getsource regex it replaced, but the evidence fragment's claim that 'where the call is written no longer matters' is slightly wider than what the case holds.
